name: Mira
greeting: I heard the apology. I need to see who gets protected when the next hard choice comes. That isn't work I can do for you.
lines: Mira: We can talk. We can be kind. We cannot pretend the question went away.

actions.label: Then friendship, without asking you to wait for me.

relationship_event.text: Kael respected Mira's boundary and chose friendship without asking her to wait.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You didn't ask me to wait for a different answer. Thank you.
